finding: Turn 125 evaluated PBS Job 1417249 (Package 108 R1) and proved that Stage B cutbacks were caused by coupling-architecture mismatch: R1 left both displacement and phase DOFs simultaneously active without an off-diagonal Jacobian (K_ud=0, K_du=0 in UEL), degenerating to un-relaxed Block-Jacobi Picard iterations under forward loading. Corrected in Package 108 Revision 2 (108_r2_c3_staggered_continuation) implementing canonical multi-step alternating minimization with boundary switching (*Boundary, fixed on N_ALL, 3, 3 during Step 2 forward mech solve; *Boundary, op=NEW, fixed on N_ALL, 1, 2 during Step 3 phase solve). Package 108-R2 passed Abaqus 2023 datacheck (Exit 0, 0 errors) and governed preflight, and was submitted as PBS Job 1417251.mmaster02. Job 1417251 completed with Exit 0 in 39s walltime: Step 1 same-load re-equilibration converged in 6 iterations matching reference fracture energy to 0.002% (measured 0.061016 mJ vs reference 0.061017 mJ); Step 2 forward mechanical solve converged in 1 iteration with zero phase drift; Step 3 phase relaxation completed in 10 increments reaching E_frac = 0.065200 mJ with monotonic thermodynamic dissipation (delta E_total < 0).
